items.titleEn: Should We Not Develop 'Super Intelligence'?
items.summaryEn: During 2026's Golden Week, the author read 'If We Build Super-Intelligent AI, Humanity Will Go Extinct.' It is quite a provocative title. The authors are co-directors of the Machine Intelligence Research Institute, a U.S. nonprofit organization, and have long been engaged in AGI research.
items.whyItMattersEn: Prominent AGI researchers are raising fundamental questions about the safety and existential implications of pursuing superintelligent AI development.
items.actionItemEn: AI researchers and policy makers should engage with Machine Intelligence Research Institute's perspectives on AGI safety and the conditions under which superintelligence development may be justified.
items.pickerCommentEn: This debate reflects growing recognition within the AI research community that technical capability must be balanced against existential risk considerations.

items.title: プログラミング能力はもう不要？ むしろ希少価値は高まっている
items.summary: 最近、世間のプログラミング学習に対する関心が薄れたように感じている。おそらく原因は、プログラムコードの出力が可能な生成AI（人工知能）の普及だろう。
items.whyItMatters: 最近、世間のプログラミング学習に対する関心が薄れたように感じている。おそらく原因は、プログラムコードの出力が可能な生成AI（人工知能）の普及だろう。
items.titleEn: Is Programming Skill Still Necessary? Rather, Its Scarcity Value Is Increasing
items.summaryEn: Recently, public interest in programming education appears to be declining, likely due to the proliferation of generative AI capable of outputting program code.
items.whyItMattersEn: While generative AI reduces routine coding tasks, deep programming expertise may become even more valuable for overseeing AI-generated code quality and system architecture.
items.actionItemEn: Educators and technologists should reframe programming education to emphasize architectural thinking and code review skills essential for AI-assisted development.
items.pickerCommentEn: The paradox is that AI coding assistance may increase demand for experienced engineers who can oversee, validate, and improve AI-generated code.
